title: El coste social
goal: Describe some social consequences of the debt crisis and adjustment policies, including unemployment, poverty and falling real wages.

items: Describe some social consequences of the debt crisis and adjustment policies, including unemployment, poverty and falling real wages.
Use vocabulary for unemployment, poverty and real wages.
Connect economic measures with changes in everyday life.
Avoid treating all countries as if they experienced the same effects.
Use the gerund to describe parallel developments.
